crossRefs.note: so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his…
This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.
A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.
By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”
“I command these things to you, that you may love one another.

translations.web: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.
translations.bsb: By this we know that we love the children of God: when we love God and keep His commandments.
translations.kjv: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God, and keep his commandments.
translations.asv: Hereby we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and do his commandments.
